answer_prose: Yes, their recent pace trend carries additional information. In matched groups, accelerating runners finished 3.5 minutes faster than steady runners on average.
detail_prose: The comparison holds the race edition and the one-minute 20 km time band constant.

charts.title: Finish-time difference versus steady runners
charts.note: Negative means a faster finish. All three groups use the same race and 20 km time distribution.
